cl.x: Prepare substrates in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.03) and the requirements below. Inspect the substrate against these requirements before application.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Instructions > Substrate Quality / Pre-Treatment
cl.x: The surface must be clean, dry and free of all contaminants such as dirt, oil, grease, coatings and surface treatments, etc. All dust, loose and friable material must be completely removed from all surfaces before application of the product, preferably by vacuum. Pull off strength shall not be less than 1.5 N/mm2. If in doubt apply a test area first.
Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.03) and the requirements below.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Product Information
s: Mixing ratio: Clear & Pigmented - Part A:Part B = 3:1 (by volume)
Consumption: Approx. 7-10 m2/litre/coat
Pot Life: Approx. 50 mins at ±23oC
Waiting time to overcoating: Approx. 4 hours at ±23oC
Applied product ready for use: Foot traffic: Approx. 24 hrs. at ±23oC; Heavy traffic: Approx. 48 hrs. at ±23oC
r: Clear & Pigmented - Part A:Part B = 3:1 (by volume)

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Instructions > Mixing
cl.x: Prior to mixing, stir part A mechanically. When all of part B has been added to part A, mix continuously for 2 minutes until a uniform mix has been achieved.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Instructions > Application
cl.x: Prior to application, confirm substrate moisture content, relative humidity and dew point. As a seal coat, the product can be applied by squeegee and then back-rolled (crosswise) with a short-piled roller.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Instructions > Cleaning Of Equipment
cl.x: Clean all tools and application equipment with Thinner C immediately after use. Hardened and/or cured material can only be removed mechanically.

Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. Where the data sheet states different limits for the same condition, apply the more restrictive limit and refer to manufacturer. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
